bullets.content: [general] After EVERY linear solve read top-6 hotspots (nearest face, local h vs requested) and call view(kind=error) before the next mesh call. If a hotspot is outside every refinement or >1.3x coarser than requested, extend that group/box before the next check.

[general] Write the plan up front: free-mesh scan; linear solves to place elements (one factor each); nonlinear_check on the 2-4 most promising meshes; submit the best measured A/c. Never spend the first check on a mesh already measured by a peer or note.

[general] Write a 6-check schedule (mesh# -> purpose) before the first check and use ALL slots (repeated failure: unused checks). Spend a freed slot on a node-cut sibling or the h 0.006 diagnostic. Never submit with checks left. Budget: 1 control, 3 structural DOF-cut variants, 2 spare.

[general] Order checks cheapest-first; stop a direction after two checks above break-even and an axis after 2 flat checks (±0.1 pt = exhausted). Then switch to the other assigned factor, a structurally new target, or variants of the leading recipe.
[general] One factor per solve: before each mesh call list differences from the previous call; if more than one, split. Multi-factor changes made energy changes unattributable.
[general] Never call compare(a,a): it returns noise (0.5%) and wastes a step (repeated violation). Compare the new solve with the previous one differing by exactly one factor.

[general] After every mesh call/solve compare delivered h near groups and hotspots with the request. If >1.15-1.2x requested (f2 0.0040 vs 0.003), shrink the requested size (e.g. 0.0034->0.0030) rather than adding edges.

[general] Box and group refinements deliver ~1.2-1.3x the requested size (0.0035 gave 0.0041-0.0048). Request 0.75-0.8x the wanted local h and verify via 'element size near group' and hotspot local h.

[general] Mesher branch jumps (bc0: h 0.011 gave 6429 nodes vs 5490). Free-mesh every candidate, record nodes and q.min. When a promising variant jumps (carrier bottom -0.021 at 6935, neck boxes 6970), don't abandon it: free-mesh h ±0.0002/0.0004/0.0006 to find a <=5800-node branch, then check. Jumps are mesher artifacts.

[general] Branch quality q does not predict accuracy: pocket 0.003 (q 0.273) gave 2.60% vs 0.0028 (q 0.108) 2.49%; h 0.0077 (q 0.226) gave 2.40%. Use q only as a validity gate (>=0.1); rank by checked e x nodes.
[general] Cheap targeted boxes (+<1% nodes) at secondary plastic zones beat enlarging the carrier box. Look for small boxes over mid-level PEEQ regions first.

[general] When a large volume box buys a small gain, localise it: compare with a peer's partial version (centre-only slab 0 gain, full width -0.09 pt) to find the sub-volume carrying the gain, then box only that.
[general] When an assigned variant fails at free-mesh stage (all candidates above node gate), switch at once to a new target and state its break-even in advance. This saved checks in g8.

[general] Edge refinements lag ~1.76x (bc0: 0.0017 r0.002 delivered 0.0030) and point refinements are inert. Cover corner zones with face groups or boxes >= 1.5x finer than the surroundings; check delivered h.
[general] A nested refinement must be >= 1.5x finer than its surroundings or it is mostly swallowed (bc0: 0.002 inside 0.0025 gave little for +3% DOFs).

[general] Put local refinements over the exact hotspot band (here the nonlinear PEEQ/principal-stress hotspots, xyz_mm -> metres) rather than lowering global h everywhere; on training tasks this gave the best accuracy per DOF.
[general] Choose the submission by measured error vs DOFs from your own runs, never by distance to a remembered or guessed reference (or test-force) value.
[general] When a recipe family plateaus, 0.0005 size tweaks are useless; make a structural change (other targets, h moved by > 1.5x, other order).

[general] Use mesh-only scans to choose h and sizes; spend linear solves and checks on structural tests (new target, bold h change), not tiny one-factor variants of a known plateau or brackets node count predicts.
[general] Do not spend a check on +10-20% DOFs for a marginal change. Above g=2 it needs a proportional error drop. Make each experiment structural and one-factor.

[general] Never submit a peer's exact mesh: a1 and a2 both submitted the 5743-node recipe and tied at 0.797 with no bonus. If your own checked variant is within ~3% of the best product, submit it instead.

[general] Before each nonlinear_check write nodes, q, required e (best product/nodes) and the family's best result. Skip if required e is below every family result (g4 lost checks at 2.97% and 3.41%). Don't re-measure known meshes.

[general] Make solve 1 the control mesh, then view(kind=error) in x and z (and -x) before the first nonlinear_check (repeatedly skipped). List each hotspot's local h vs its box; an unrefined hotspot is the next target.
[general] Re-issuing a mesh after the last solve cost steps. Keep the final mesh as the last mesh call, or note its solve id, so you can submit without re-meshing.

[abc_00000065_compression] Coarse global h is a dead end with 0.004 carrier: h 0.009/0.01/0.011/0.0125/0.014/0.02/0.03 gave 6989/7675/8348/9902/8133/6625/7098 nodes vs 5612 at 0.008. Do not use h>0.0085 for diversity or node cuts.

[abc_00000065_compression] Submit rule: submit the neck mesh if base >=90% of best (e x nodes <=~14.3k), even if it ties the control; no peer uses it (diversity). Else best checked variant differing from peers. Never the identical 5612-node mesh or a peer recipe.

[abc_00000065_compression] Neck-box target: mirrored boxes [±0.022..±0.031, y -0.028..-0.018, full z] 0.004 r0.004 overlapping carrier bottom by 2 mm; aim for slab's -0.09 pt for half its nodes. Break-even e<12910/nodes. Keep arm boxes for attribution; drop them (-60 nodes) as a second check only if within 0.05 pt of break-even.

[abc_00000065_compression] Full-width base slab [-0.031,-0.032,-0.0082,0.031,-0.02,0.0082] 0.0055: 5981 nodes, 2.21% (13.22k); deeper slab 6149 nodes 2.19% (13.47k). Centre-only slabs 2.30%, no gain: gain is at outer necks. Slab not better than base; don't add it.

[abc_00000065_compression] Boxes reaching |x|=0.031 below y -0.02 are branchy: slab h 0.008 5981, 0.0079 5984, 0.0081 7588, 0.006/0.0055 variants 6971-7473. If neck mesh >6000 nodes, free-mesh neck y-min -0.027/-0.029, x-min ±0.021/±0.023 and h 0.0079 before discarding.

[abc_00000065_compression] Score is A/c with g>2, so each 10% DOF cut is worth ~10% score. Try a cheaper mesh ~4500 nodes even at e 3.5%. Try carrier box shrunk to y -0.012..0.032, x ±0.027 with pocket boxes kept; free-mesh first, gate nodes <=5000.
[abc_00000065_compression] Keep both pocket boxes (right and left, mirrored, 0.0025, full z): PEEQ peaks 0.29/0.19 lie there; only refinements still moving e.

[abc_00000065_compression] Spend one check on the h 0.006 diagnostic (control with only h 0.008->0.006; promised and skipped in g8). If 1.0 mm point (+5.56-5.65%) drops >1 pt, excess stiffness is outside carrier (base/necks) and neck/slab direction is right.

[abc_00000065_compression] Never check a more expensive version of a target that missed break-even (mesh 15: 6149 nodes, 2.19%). Check the cheaper localised version first; enlarge only if e<12910/nodes. Don't re-scan h; prefer structural DOF cuts over near-duplicates.

[abc_00000065_compression] After solve 1 call view(kind=error, view=-z) and view(kind=mesh); read hotspots BEFORE spending checks. Local h at neck/base junction (x ±27 mm, y -22 mm): ~0.008 justifies neck boxes; ~0.005 means slab gain was noise, change target.

[abc_00000065_compression] [general] [abc_00000065_compression] Before checking, look up whether the value is already in notes (g6 re-checked h 0.0081-0.0083, wasting 3 of 6 checks). A known point gets at most one confirmation check.

[abc_00000065_compression] [general] [abc_00000065_compression] Best base (a1 g7): h 0.008, carrier 0.004, pockets 0.0025, arms 0.0034: 5612 nodes, q 0.221, 2.30%, 12.91k. Break-even e<12910/nodes. Never resubmit unchanged. Earlier g5: 5737 nodes, 2.42%, 13.88k.

[abc_00000065_compression] [general] [abc_00000065_compression] Arm boxes at 0.004 inside the 0.004 carrier are inert (5551 nodes = no boxes); at 0.0034 +61 nodes for -0.06 pt (noise). Keep 0.0034 only to stay on best recipe; never scan arm size again.

[abc_00000065_compression] [general] [abc_00000065_compression] Highlight a2: carrier top y 0.035->0.032 coarsens prong tops (PEEQ~0): 5737->5549 nodes, e 2.42->2.45%, product 13.88k->13.60k. Top 0.031/0.033 jump to 6834/5623 (q 0.136). Use 0.032 as base.

[abc_00000065_compression] [general] [abc_00000065_compression] Highlight a3: mirrored neck boxes [±0.024..±0.031, y -0.025..-0.016, full z] 0.0034 r0.003, h 0.0082: 5697 nodes, 2.42%, 13.79k; without 2.55%. Neck 0.003-0.0032 jumps to 7473-7978 nodes. a3's target; don't copy.

[abc_00000065_compression] [general] [abc_00000065_compression] Pocket boxes vs groups at 0.0025 similar (5754/2.45% boxes; groups 2.42-2.51%). Keep boxes 6x6.5x16.4 mm; larger 7x8.5 gave 5877 nodes. Pocket 0.0024-0.0028 is noise (0.0025 2.30% vs 0.0026 2.43%, maybe lucky): never scan pocket size again.

[abc_00000065_compression] [general] [abc_00000065_compression] [general] [abc_00000065_compression] Left round pocket f15/f37 (x -23.7, y 25.7, z ±6 mm) keeps PEEQ 0.17 unrefined. A box at 0.0025-0.0028 is the only refinement still moving e (a3 2.42-2.45%, a0 f37 0.0027 2.40%). Always include, mirrored with right pocket.

[abc_00000065_compression] [general] [abc_00000065_compression] Carrier bottom must stay at -0.02 or lower: raising to -0.018 cost +0.16 pt (2.46% vs 2.30%) for -50 nodes; neck band y -0.02..-0.018 carries post-yield stiffness.

[abc_00000065_compression] [general] [abc_00000065_compression] [general] [abc_00000065_compression] Carrier box is exhausted at h 0.008 with pockets 0.0025: only 0.004 gives q 0.22/5743 nodes; 0.0043 gave 2.97%/6051, 0.0045 3.41%/5671. Never scan or check carrier box again; keep 0.004.
